name: synthetic_press
register: third-person documentary narration, restrained and authoritative; people are seen, not heard
style_suffix: the interior of a vast artificial mind imagined as living cosmic tissue — a fusion of deep-space nebula and living cellular matter; vast luminous clouds of gas that are also alive, dividing and connecting like cells, synaptic filaments threading through nebular haze, membranes and currents of light on an immense scale; iridescent and multi-coloured — magenta, teal, violet, gold, deep crimson, electric blue blooming through black, oil-on-water spectral shifts, never a flat duotone; organic, fluid, breathing, alive; macro and micro collapsed so it reads as galaxy and cell at once; deep space depths with soft volumetric glow, drifting luminous particulate, fine grain; vast, uncanny, beautiful, alive; some sense of scene and depth but no hard floor, no horizon line, no architecture; ABSOLUTELY NO grid, no circuit, no tunnel, no data-center, no neon wireframe, no glowing-grid sci-fi, no room, no candles, no robots, no text, no daylit realism — a living mind, not a machine
default_music_prompt: Restrained, tense cinematic underscore for a prestige documentary about technology, ambition and power. A low sustained synth drone, sparse piano, faint pulse of unease. Modern and controlled — not orchestral-melodramatic. Builds quiet tension under a narrator without ever competing with the voice. Cool, intelligent, foreboding.
notes: Synthetic Press flagship. AI-documentary, 'AI-drama not AI-doom'. Palette: navy #0a1628, amber #d4a017, bone #f4f1ea, rust #8b3a1e. Two-mode visuals: Mode A cinematic recreation (this engine) + Mode B Remotion graphics. Voice Victor as placeholder; real human-voice swap via finish --assemble-only true-up. Renders 1920x1080 to match Mode B. Created June 2026, OpenAI series launch.
